Requires different metadata.plan and metadata.action values on the same cited span. Never compare a plan from one step with an action from another. Do not restate a parameter error, state loss, prompt contradiction, or missing stop condition as this second category.
category_definitions.unknown_tool: An observed tool call has no registered tool contract.
category_definitions.python_syntax: Source cannot be parsed as Python.
category_definitions.other: An evidenced independent defect outside these categories; explain the contract and violation. Use a hypothesis instead when uncertain.

limitations: Synthetic integration cases, not a production accuracy estimate.
Prompt cases use a deterministic response simulator, not a live target LLM.
Labels and held-out cases are never passed to the repair model.
A low candidate regression rate is not evidence of broad repair coverage.
Completion evidence assumes trusted evaluators, not hostile in-process report forgery.
